findings.body: The branch contains no changes under `frontend/src/features/financial-chat/financial-result*`, `monthly-trend.tsx`, or `frontend/src/components/ui/`; it only records the VALUES task as working. Consequently this part does not render exact Actual/Budget strings, Actual-only Cost Center results, or the required Unmapped, missing-Budget, missing-Actual, and partial-data states.

findings.body: No monthly-trend implementation was added or changed. The branch therefore does not deliver the assigned frontend behavior for backend-provided values, missing-month gaps, partial-value exclusion, changes, or closing Roll-over balances.
findings.title: Not done: monthly trends preserve exact values, gaps, changes, and closing balances

findings.body: No result test was added or changed to prove that large and negative paise-precise decimal strings are displayed exactly. This is an explicitly required VALUES-owned test.
findings.title: Not done: large/negative exact strings

findings.body: No result test was added or changed for the required Unmapped and missing-Budget presentation states, including distinguishing an unloaded Plant/month from a loaded month with no GL Budget line.

findings.body: No result test proves that incomplete Actual appears only as an available subtotal and is excluded from complete Actual comparisons, deltas, percentages, and chart points.
findings.title: Not done: partial exclusion

findings.body: No result test was added or changed to prove that missing months remain gaps instead of being displayed as zero or complete data.
